runs.content: UPS beat Q3 on pricing power (US revenue per piece +6.1% despite volume −3%) and raised FY26 revenue and operating-profit guidance, yet trades only ~2.9% above its pre-report price; CRM was trimmed for capacity at −3.02% (NDX-put overlap, failed momentum).

Unilever (prices in GBX) beat Q3 on volume (USG 5.2%, volume 2.9%) and raised its FY26 volume guide to at least 3% as staples lead the rotation out of tech; the RDW remainder was trimmed for capacity at $7.83, a blended +26.12% and the largest closed win.
